attchmntText: Nectar Lifesciences Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nectar Lifesciences Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The meeting commenced at 10:30 A.M. IST and concluded at 11:45 A.M. IST. Independent auditor Deepak Jindal & Co. issued review reports stating that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the financial statements prepared under Indian Accounting Standard 34. The consolidated results include subsidiaries Neclife PT, Unipessal LDA and Avensis Exports Private Limited. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the unreviewed subsidiary information reflects total revenue of Nil, total net loss after tax of Rs. 22.09 Lakhs, and total comprehensive loss of Rs. 22.09 million. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the unreviewed subsidiary information shows total revenue of Nil, total net loss after tax of Rs. 448.34 Lakhs, and total comprehensive loss of Rs. 448.34 lakhs. The auditor concluded that this interim financial information is not material to the Group.
